observedWindowPolicy: Permit a 28px body-supported short approach behind currently observed non-approaching enemies; reobserve every350ms. No AI state or future patrol access.
diagnosticDisclosure: Controlled world and/or ordinary mature two-tool fixture selected before departure; no field HP, loot, clock or position edits. Does not count as natural supply.
